scope: supplement T3 negative t3code-relay filter static audit

method.dependencyGraph: Start from root importer and selected test/source package owners; follow dependency declarations resolving to active workspace package names, including workspace aliases.
method.sourceScan: Scan TS/TSX/MTS/CTS/JS/JSX/MJS/CJS/Vue files in reachable non-root workspace package directories plus all selected source/test files.
method.importDetection: Static import/export/dynamic-import string scan for relay package names, infra/relay literals, resolvable relative paths, and tsconfig path aliases targeting infra/relay.
method.workspaceMembership: Resolve root pnpm workspace package globs or root package.json workspaces.
method.limitations: Static analysis does not execute code and cannot detect arbitrary computed imports or dynamic runtime loading. It conservatively follows all declared dependencies that resolve to active workspace packages.
